mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200k, and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0% and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth > 0% and RSAFS increases > 1% MoM, and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
